events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your cancelled ride and found the cancellation fee shouldn't have been charged. The driver marked they'd arrived, but their location at that moment was still about 39 metres from the pickup point, so the arrival notice doesn't count. As a result, we're refunding the full $6.61 to you as a Ryde voucher, added to your account automatically. No further action is needed on your part.

DRIVER: We reviewed the cancellation you reported as a no-show and found it didn't meet the waiting requirement, so the cancellation fee was refunded to the rider. Although you pressed "I'm Here" at 14:13:10, you were still about 39 metres from the pickup point at that time, so the arrival couldn't be counted. This means no-show cancellations won't be upheld unless you're at the pickup point for more than 3 minutes. Please make sure you're at the pin before starting the wait timer. Repeated issues may lead to a review of your account.
